response.justification: The candidate lacks direct experience in hardware optimization, SoC/IP modeling, or AI accelerator architectures, which are core requirements for this role. While Bogdan Szabo demonstrates strong software engineering skills and leadership in web/mobile development, his background does not align with the hardware-software co-design, deep-learning workload optimization, or GPU architecture expertise needed for this Principal Performance Architect position.
strengths: Strong software engineering background with experience in full-stack development and distributed systems.
Proven ability to optimize and scale applications, including low-latency systems and real-time metadata handling.
Active contributor to open-source projects and technical communities, showing passion for software craftsmanship.
concerns: No demonstrated experience in hardware architecture, SoC/IP modeling, or AI accelerator optimization.
Lacks required background in deep neural network training/inference optimization or GPU workload analysis.
No evidence of work with SIMD/MIMD architectures or hardware-software co-design in the resume.
